replies.author: Diabolicx
replies.body:
I agree with cellish, it's a bit too thin.

As for the aesthetics, the map isn't stunning, but it also isn't ugly. The stone looks a bit dull, but I saw that you mixed it up with cobble and mossy cobble on some lanes which is good, so you could maybe do that throughout the map. Also the lanes on the side seem to abruptly end and they kinda look cut off. If you want to keep them, I suggest you add a couple of blocks to kind of mark their ending (the slabs for example).

As for gameplay, I have no idea how this will play, but I do have some suggestions: make the monuments islands closer to the lanes on the side and a bit further away from spawn, and maybe raise their hight so that they're above spawn but below the edge lanes. As for the island between the 2 bases, I can kinda see 2 structures connected by some bridge. Either remove all of it, or remove the bridge connecting them. 

Anyways, all of this is my opinion, it's up to you whether you want to listen to me or not :P good job on the map

replies.author: Myv
replies.body: It looks very interesting, although I think it's too wide in terms of getting from one side to the other and not long enough. This might actually be a unique and reasonably effective way of designing these maps that we have not really seen before,but all the fundamentals seem to be there except for the fact the lanes seem a bit thin. If you could list the world name and the server it is on I can come on and give better feedback/maybe help out.

replies.author: Riilo
replies.body: This map is actually quite unique. Like mentioned above, most of the lanes are quite thin and could use an extra 3 or 4 blocks in width. From the image, the void gap looks fine but there is one big issue. I can't really tell, considering you may have hidden it, but it looks like there is no bedrock under the monument. Teams can just break the whole island in about a minute or two, and it's just a floating obsidian block. Good job so far though, and I would also recommend putting all of your images into an imgur album as it's easier than posting each photo individually.
